pages.title: Claw Machine : Animal Friends
pages.creator: Haz Studio
pages.description: Catch plush animals in Claw Machine : Animal Friends. Position the claw, drop it over a toy, and carry the prize to the chute. Complete collections and missions to unlock more machines.

pages.title: Plane Evolution 3D
pages.creator: 4Y Games Mobile
pages.description: Fly through neon gates in Plane Evolution 3D while steering around spikes and saw blades. Break mystery cubes on your route and try aircraft from different eras as you progress.

pages.title: Build a Go-Kart
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Assemble a track from modular blocks in Build a Go-Kart. Try adding boosts or riskier turns and see how the route affects earnings. Spend what the rides bring in to expand.

pages.title: Merge Blocks 2048
pages.creator: KekeFWT
pages.description: Slide matching numbers together in Merge Blocks 2048. Every move adds pressure to the four-by-four board, so look for chains of merges. Use earned coins for tools such as Undo.

pages.title: SuperPixelint
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Build a small picture by matching colors in SuperPixelint. Work carefully through the image and use the different shades to distinguish neighboring details as the drawing takes shape.

pages.title: Shadowman Runner
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Run through a shadowy landscape in Shadowman Runner. Read the outlines ahead as you time moves around obstacles, then try to keep the run going farther on your next attempt.

pages.title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
pages.creator: Welwise Studio
pages.description: Play matches or take penalties in Obby Football Soccer 3D. Try to score and save shots against other players, or take on football-themed obstacle courses to practice your timing.

pages.title: Going Balls 3D
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Tilt a wooden platform to roll the ball in Going Balls 3D. Drag with the mouse or swipe to steer, and keep the ball away from the edge until it reaches the finish.

pages.title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Grow a movie theater in Cinema Business - Idle Games. Add screening rooms and food counters, hire staff, and improve the facilities. The theater continues earning while you're away.

pages.title: Yummy Trails
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Guide the hungry snake along a trail in Yummy Trails. Look for a route that lets it reach the food, and think through the twists before you start moving.

pages.title: Quiz Master
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Answer timed questions in Quiz Master across topics such as geography and pop culture. Correct answers earn protective blocks, so each response helps you stay in the contest.

pages.title: Tobinin
pages.creator: Liminal Creations Pvt. Ltd.
pages.description: Collect orbs that change the platforms in Tobinin. Pay attention to how the route shifts after each pickup, and choose the right time to jump toward the goal.

pages.title: Sticker Book Puzzle Color By Number
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Drag numbered stickers into place in Sticker Book Puzzle Color By Number. Match each piece to the corresponding spot and see the illustration come together as you fill it in.

pages.title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Swipe a sponge through the maze in Paint Sponges Puzzle. Cover every square in paint and plan your turns around traps and corridors so you can reach the remaining spaces.

pages.title: Fast Ball Jump
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Roll and jump through the courses in Fast Ball Jump. Guide the ball around obstacles as the environments change. Keep track of your landings to avoid losing lives.

pages.title: Mega Makeup - Seasons Best
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Design a makeup look for each month in Mega Makeup - Seasons Best. Use Pro Mode for precise looks or experiment with lipstick, eyeshadow, gems, and accessories in Freestyle.

pages.title: Farm Tiles Harvest
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Draw farm tiles into the holding area in Farm Tiles Harvest and clear them in groups of three. Watch the clock and make a match before a ninth tile ends the game.

pages.title: Pixel Art
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Click squares and fill them with the appropriate colors in Pixel Art. Work through the small blocks until the picture is complete and use nearby shades to guide your choices.

pages.title: Basketball Damage
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Move the ball with A and D in Basketball Damage. Time the bounce to score before the clock expires, and see how many baskets you can make without ending the run.

pages.title: Eye Attack - Toilet Monster War
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Take aim as a secret agent in Eye Attack - Toilet Monster War. Work out shots that destroy the toilet monsters and solve each setup to hold off the invasion.

pages.title: Block puzzle
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Drag pieces onto the grid in Block puzzle and fill complete lines to clear space. Look at how the shapes fit together before leaving a gap that might be hard to use.

pages.title: Monster Truck Crazy Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race monster trucks on dirt in Monster Truck Crazy Racing. Use boost when you have room to accelerate and keep the truck under control as you approach the next turn.

pages.title: Slime Farmer Advanced
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Rotate a turret in Slime Farmer Advanced and fire at slimes before they reach the farm. Earn coins for taking them out, and watch for the larger monster slime.

pages.title: Last Stickman Fighter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run, jump, and fight in four-stick free-for-alls in Last Stickman Fighter. Keep moving between attacks and try to come out ahead as you work through the rounds.

pages.title: Pool Party 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match water balloons by color in Pool Party 2. Join Bunni at the water park and clear balloons as you work through each board's goals.

pages.title: Cookies Must Die Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Send Jack into battle against mutant cookies in Cookies Must Die Online. Use his powers to move through the city and attack, then adjust your approach when a boss fights back.

pages.title: Pop Jewels
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Click or tap groups of at least two matching jewels in Pop Jewels. Larger groups are worth more per jewel, so compare the clusters before deciding which one to clear.

pages.title: Battle Heroes 3
pages.creator: winxland.ru
pages.description: Serve as a border mercenary in Battle Heroes 3. Use combat and magic, improve your hero and defenders, and look for materials to craft items or raise a creature.

pages.title: Xtreme City Drift 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drift through city streets in Xtreme City Drift 3D. Reach checkpoints before time runs out and use bends to practice controlled slides. Try faster vehicles as they become available.

pages.title: Pixel Survive Western
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description: Survive in the desert in Pixel Survive Western. Choose a tool to gather resources or switch to a weapon when enemies appear. Use the mouse to attack or dodge.

pages.title: Hit The Christmas Elves
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Throw snowballs at elf blocks in Hit The Christmas Elves. Use the mouse to aim and watch the number on each block to see how many hits it still needs.

pages.title: 10x10 Winter Gems
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Fit shapes into rows and columns in 10x10 Winter Gems. Full lines vanish and open up space, so consider where the next pieces could go before filling a gap.

pages.title: Stick Fighter 3D
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Trade punches, kicks, and special moves in Stick Fighter 3D. Fight alone or share the game with a friend, and time your attacks around the other fighter's moves.

pages.title: My Little Pet Salon
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Run a salon with a little panda in My Little Pet Salon. Help the animal customers with hair and nail care, then put together the finishing touches for each visit.

pages.title: Run impostor Run
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Get the impostor through twenty levels in Run impostor Run. Use WASD and double jumps to cross hazards. Watch for flying creatures and land on enemies when you need to clear them.

pages.title: Yummy Tales
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Match fruit and vegetables to feed the farm animals in Yummy Tales. Work through the orders with Oscar the dog and clear the produce each animal needs.

pages.title: Rotative Pipes Puzzle
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Turn tiles to link the entire network in Rotative Pipes Puzzle. Follow each connection and check any pipe ends still pointing into empty space before moving to the next board.

pages.title: Stair Run 3D
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Build stairs under your runner in Stair Run 3D. Click or tap to climb over obstacles, and use any stairs you have left at the finish to go for a bonus.

pages.title: Mahjong Battles Egypt
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Take turns matching tiles in Mahjong Battles Egypt. Each pair earns money, so look for matches that can put you ahead of your rival before the board is cleared.

pages.title: Sports Word Puzzle
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Unscramble the letters in Sports Word Puzzle to find the name of a sport. Use the mouse to arrange your answer and check how the letters fit together.

pages.title: Cars Paint 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Use cars to paint the route in Cars Paint 3D. Work out when to send each car through the layout and cover the track as you solve the levels.

pages.title: Fashion Competition
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Get ready to face the judges in Fashion Competition. Start with skincare, then choose makeup, a hairstyle, and an outfit that work together for the contest.

pages.title: Hanger 2 HTML5
pages.creator: A Small Game
pages.description: Swing through levels on a rope in Hanger 2 HTML5. Press to swing past obstacles such as buzz saws and collect coins to unlock or upgrade characters.

pages.title: Green Park Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Look for a way out of a locked park in Green Park Escape. Click through the grounds, pick up useful items, and see how they connect to the puzzles you find.

pages.title: Ghost Wiper
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Investigate a haunted house with two brothers in Ghost Wiper. Work through its rooms and traps as you deal with the creatures that have taken over the building.

pages.title: Against Coronavirus Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six health-themed illustrations in Against Coronavirus Puzzle. Choose one of four piece counts, then use matching details to work through the jigsaw with the mouse.

pages.title: Color Flow
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Change the color of the top-right area in Color Flow to absorb neighboring tiles. Pick from six colors and make the entire board one color within 22 moves.

pages.title: Around The World In 2 Seconds
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Circle the planet in Around The World In 2 Seconds. Jump the Eiffel Tower each time it comes around and see how many trips you can make before it stops you.

pages.title: Carrot Cake
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Bake a carrot cake in Carrot Cake. Follow the recipe to work grated carrots and walnuts into the batter, then finish it with cream cheese frosting.

pages.title: Train Snake
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Hold to move the train in Train Snake and release to stop. Pick up every passenger and time your starts so you can get through obstacles to the destination.

pages.title: Three Cars
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Manage three moving cars at once in Three Cars. Watch for flags and traffic cones in each lane. Missing a flag or hitting an obstacle ends the run.

pages.title: Knife Master
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Click to launch the blade in Knife Master. Watch the aim before throwing and try to hit apples as you climb. Keep the run going to beat your score.

pages.title: Memory Game With Numbers
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Listen to how numbers are spoken in Memory Game With Numbers. Use the mouse to explore the number activity or switch to the memory game to practice remembering what you saw.

pages.title: Modern And Old Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Build jigsaws of vehicles from different eras in Modern And Old Cars Jigsaw. Choose among twelve pictures and play with 25, 49, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Bomber io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Place bombs to clear a route in Bomber io. Move with WASD and drop explosives with space. Get out of range before the blast and try single-player or multiplayer.

pages.title: Cute Cars And Trucks Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Line up three or more identical vehicles in Cute Cars And Trucks Match 3. Keep making matches to build points before the meter on the left falls too low.

pages.title: Kawaii Magical Girl Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Design an anime-style magical fighter in Kawaii Magical Girl Dress Up Game. Use the avatar maker to try different looks and put together a character with the style you want.

pages.title: Ice Cream Birthday Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare a party with Mia, Emma, Bella, and Olivia in Ice Cream Birthday Party. Decorate the ice cream and hall, then choose an outfit for each friend.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Highschool Room
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Dotted Girl tidy up before homework in Dotted Girl Highschool Room. Clear trash, sort clothes, and dust, then choose decorations once the room is ready for a makeover.

pages.title: Air Force Shooter Sky Strike
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fly against an alien invasion in Air Force Shooter Sky Strike. Move through the incoming attacks and fire back as you clear enemy craft and work your way toward their boss.

pages.title: Block Pusher
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Swipe to push objects off the course in Block Pusher. Aim your movement through groups of blocks and see how much of each structure you can knock down.

pages.title: Superhero Memory Match
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find pairs of comic heroes in Superhero Memory Match. Remember where characters such as Wonder Woman, Iron Man, and Batman appear as you turn over cards to clear the layout.

pages.title: Speedy Worm
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a worm over and under obstacles in Speedy Worm. Use the up arrow to jump and the down arrow to dig, choosing the move that clears what is ahead.

pages.title: EG Go Bowling 2
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Roll the ball at the pins in EG Go Bowling 2. Aim for a strike or spare, then adjust to the faster pace as the game continues.

pages.title: Monster Truck Coloring
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Paint one of six drawings in Monster Truck Coloring with a choice of 24 shades. Work quickly for a higher score, then save or print the finished truck.

pages.title: Space Run
pages.creator: stoneye
pages.description: Escape a meteor shower in Space Run. Find openings between falling rocks and stay clear of the nails as you try to keep moving long enough to set a better score.

pages.title: Punch Man
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Punch to either side in Punch Man as enemies approach. Keep striking before the timer runs down and watch for power-ups that strengthen your attacks.

pages.title: Winter Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Assemble one of six wintry truck pictures in Winter Truck Jigsaw. Choose a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces and use details in the vehicle and snow to find the joins.

pages.title: Music Line 3
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Keep the line on its path in Music Line 3. Follow the rhythm through twelve levels and six pieces of music, and try the different skins as you collect them.

pages.title: Highway Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Thread a car through busy lanes in Highway Traffic. Choose from four solo modes and three weather settings, and try vehicles ranging from sedans to sports cars.

pages.title: Whack em All
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Tap the moles as they appear in Whack em All. Hit as many as possible before time runs out, and grab the Super Hammer to double your points.

pages.title: PixelArt Color By Number
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Color a grid by following the numbers in PixelArt Color By Number, or paint the squares in your own colors. Add finished pixel pictures to your album.

pages.title: Bitcoin Tap Tap Mine
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build up a virtual mining operation in Bitcoin Tap Tap Mine. Collect in-game bitcoin and spend it on hardware that improves your earning rate, then work toward the next upgrade.

pages.title: Quadron
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Command a team of space fighters in Quadron. Click or tap to use each fighter's powers and choose when to switch tactics against the enemies in front of you.

pages.title: Kids Drum Drum Piano
pages.creator: ReCorp Games
pages.description: Play keys and follow the notes in Kids Drum Drum Piano. Each press lights up a key and plays a sound, with animated characters representing the English note names.

pages.title: Fazenda
pages.creator: ale
pages.description: Raise animals and sell produce in Fazenda. Start by feeding chickens and selling eggs in the village, then use the coins to grow the farm and unlock more animals.

pages.title: Zombie Cows
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Tap zombie cows as they pop up in Zombie Cows. Reach the target score to open the next of seven stages, and be ready for the challenge to increase.

pages.title: Save the Princess: Love Triangle
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Place cake arrows to steer the prince in Save the Princess: Love Triangle. Route him around spikes and toward the potion he needs to turn the princess human again.

pages.title: Ben and Kitty Photo Session
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pick outfits for two newlyweds in Ben and Kitty Photo Session. Dress Ben and Kitty separately, then see how the looks work together in their wedding photos.
